scope: Assembly and independent schema/path/integrity checks of the ancillary package; no model estimation, source-data access, bootstrap generation or new scientific diagnostics.
base_audit: All 175 hashes in the original 176-file audited base manifest verified.
figure_provenance_changes: Removed internal review/manuscript routing, distinguished historical source checks, and mapped package output paths; no numerical figure metadata changed.

privacy.record_identifier_tables: Only six cited public annual-report cases; no new identifier-bearing table.
privacy.function_grid: 10,040 deterministic saved-function evaluations, not company-level predictions.
privacy.display_bins: 2,053 hexagon cells, 20 median bins, 280 histogram bins, 8 signal summaries, 6 annual metric rows, 4 aggregate contrast rows, 10 aggregate coefficient rows.

offline_builder_boundary: code/build_paper_tables.py derives ROOT from its own package directory; all writes target ROOT/output/paper-assets. No manuscript paths or writes.
tex_exclusion: The five generated TeX files from the base bundle are omitted. Scripts can recreate them locally.
historical_validation: The former package-validation.json is preserved byte-for-byte as base-package-validation.json.
verification_limits: Fresh dependency download/installation and full source-data re-estimation were not run; the tested existing Python environment was used for offline figures.
